notes: Jyutping and register mostly sound. Fixed: 寧願 to dictionary ning4 jyun6; Mandarin-ish 班上; 見面 (off-gloss) in 面; awkward 都病; added colloquial 閂/熄 note to 關. All CHECKs reviewed; rest are correct colloquial readings.
